info.title: Open-Meteo Forecast (night sky)
info.description: Open-Meteo's free, keyless forecast, requested for one purpose: cloud cover hour by hour through tonight. With `timezone=auto` the hourly arrays start at LOCAL 00:00 today, so array index N is local hour N — the same index means the same local hour at every place on earth, which is what lets a producer project 'cloud at 22:00 tonight' as a fixed path.

get.summary: Hourly cloud cover and visibility for a coordinate pair, indexed by local hour
get.description: Returns parallel arrays under `hourly` — `time[]`, `cloud_cover[]` (percent) and `visibility[]` (metres). With `timezone=auto` and `forecast_days=2`, index 0 is local 00:00 today and index 47 is local 23:00 tomorrow; indices 20-28 are tonight 20:00 through tomorrow 04:00.

parameters.name: forecast_days
parameters.description: Days of forecast. `2` covers tonight and the small hours.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: `auto` resolves the place's own timezone, which is what makes hourly indices mean local hours.
